rust_summary: a camera a mod draws the world from (`native_camera_pose`).
doc_summary: `native_camera_pose(partial, position, yaw, pitch)` (client) runs every world frame after vanilla placed the camera (first or third person, a spectated mob, a minecart), with its position and its yaw and pitch in degrees. Set them to draw the world from anywhere: a cinematic, replay or film camera. The picture, culling, the sound's listener and what faces the camera (particles, item sprites, block entity text) follow it; the player, where they aim, the first-person hand (cancel it with `native_render_hand`) and which chunks load stay the player's. Values that aren't finite keep vanilla's. The field of view is `native_compute_fov`'s. Not called on the title screen's panorama. Bundles need "hooks": @API:camera_pose@.
